# TPC-DS-OBT Q79

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  obt.bill_customer_c_last_name,
  obt.bill_customer_c_first_name,
  SUBSTRING(obt.store_s_city FROM 1 FOR 30),
  obt.sale_id,
  amt,
  profit
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    sub_obt.sale_id AS ms_sale_id,
    sub_obt.ship_customer_sk AS ms_ship_customer_sk,
    store_s_city,
    SUM(sub_obt.coupon_amt) AS amt,
    SUM(sub_obt.net_profit) AS profit
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS sub_obt
  WHERE
    (
      sub_obt.sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND sub_obt.store_sk = store_s_store_sk
      AND sub_obt.ship_hdemo_sk = bill_hdemo_hd_demo_sk
      AND (
        bill_hdemo_hd_dep_count = 0 OR bill_hdemo_hd_vehicle_count > -1
      )
      AND sold_date_d_dow = 1
      AND sold_date_d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1, 1998 + 2)
      AND store_s_number_employees BETWEEN 200 AND 295
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    sub_obt.sale_id,
    sub_obt.ship_customer_sk,
    sub_obt.ship_addr_sk,
    store_s_city
) AS ms
WHERE
  obt.sale_id = ms.ms_sale_id
  AND obt.ship_customer_sk = ms.ms_ship_customer_sk
  AND obt.ship_customer_sk = obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk
  AND channel = 'store'
ORDER BY
  obt.bill_customer_c_last_name,
  obt.bill_customer_c_first_name,
  SUBSTRING(obt.store_s_city FROM 1 FOR 30),
  profit
LIMIT 100
```
